'''CZK Sandcrawler''' was a [[Sandcrawler/Legends|Sandcrawler]] model manufactured by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
CZK Sandcrawler appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]'' as a housing decoration available from the Constable Stronghold Pack.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]'' {{1st}}
